neighbours.label: (gate-closed) the end of a multi-line Python header: '):\n' after a wrapped argument list, and the line closing it

short: end of a wrapped Python header
notes: Card: '):\n' 5, blank or indent lines otherwise; gate-closed (-x- echo 94%), weak (max 4.47). Probes: 0.30-0.31 for wrapped headers, 0.04-0.09 for plain code. Near misses are the same headers on one line.
